sectors.trend: AI trade leads market gains; Nvidia valuation normalizes after peak, Alibaba launches competitive AI chip, Meta revives AI narrative. Corporate AI debt issuance surging but buyers growing selective.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle remains robust but valuation discipline returning. Alibaba chip signals US-China tech decoupling accelerating. Selective AI debt suggests credit markets pricing in execution risk.

sectors.trend: Crude tumbles to 2-week low on Saudi pipeline restart and Iran diplomacy. Record tanker rates paradoxically signal fleet structural issues. Diesel shortage to persist into 2027. Oil/gas PE deals stalling.
sectors.implications: Near-term oil price pressure benefits consumers and airlines but hurts E&P equities. Diesel shortage creates arbitrage opportunities. PE dry-up signals capital rotation out of energy.

sectors.trend: Bitcoin nears $85K, Ethereum surges to January levels. Binance-Circle $100M deal signals institutional USDC adoption. World Liberty profits despite missed targets.
sectors.implications: Crypto entering risk-on regime. Stablecoin infrastructure maturing. Regulatory clarity improving but political entanglement (World Liberty) adds governance risk.

sectors.trend: Viking Therapeutics obesity data shocks market, pressuring Lilly/Novo. FDA approves Fayuvi for Ultragenyx. Twist Bioscience expands AI drug discovery via Lilly partnership. Chinese biopharma jumps on US deal optimism.
sectors.implications: Obesity drug competition intensifying, compressing margins for incumbents. AI-driven drug discovery accelerating timelines. US-China biopharma cooperation a positive geopolitical signal.

sectors.trend: Home Depot CFO warns of 'frozen' housing market with historic low metric. 30-year mortgage above 7%. Luxury earnings estimates too optimistic. Fast-food breakfast cancellations signal cost pressure.
sectors.implications: Housing remains structurally challenged. Consumer discretionary under pressure. Luxury sector faces earnings revision risk. Rate sensitivity remains elevated.

sectors.trend: F-35A rollout strengthens NATO deterrence (Lockheed Martin). Moscow asset seizures spook Japanese firms in Russia. Ecuador seeks US help on $30B cocaine trade.
sectors.implications: Defense spending structurally elevated. Russia exposure remains a tail risk for multinationals. Geopolitical fragmentation increasing compliance costs.

market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely range-bound with AI as primary driver. Oil weakness supports tech and consumer discretionary. Trump-Xi summit this week is key catalyst—successful talks boost risk assets, failure triggers volatility. Crypto momentum continues but watch for profit-taking above $85K BTC. Bond yields may fall on soft oil and weak eco data per JPM's Berro.
market_outlook.long_term: US fiscal trajectory remains the dominant macro risk. Housing freeze may persist 12-18 months given rate environment. AI capex cycle enters consolidation phase with winners/losers differentiating. Oil structurally challenged by pipeline restarts and diplomacy but diesel shortage provides floor. Obesity drug market expanding but competitive intensity rising. Defense spending structurally elevated.
